{{Quote|I hope you're feeling better, Master. 'Cause look what we found.|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], upon seeing the Separatist base on Maridun|<ref name="Defenders" />}}
The '''mobile command center''' was a type of base used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
The command center was large enough to fit a [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]], a [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle]], one [[Separatist command center/Legends|Separatist command center]], three [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AATs]], several [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]], [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] and [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|DSD1 dwarf spider droids]] and still have room for cargo storage. The base could be taken apart and fitted into a [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]], but it decreased the craft's cargo capacity enormously.<ref name="Defenders" />

==History==
The base was used on [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]] where [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]] employed it as his main base from where he could test a new weapon for the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Army]] known as a [[Defoliator/Legends|defoliator]].<ref name="Defenders" /> The weapon could exterminate organic matter without harming mechanical objects. Little did he know that [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], and the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] [[Bly/Legends|Bly]] and [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] were stranded on the planet and were looking for a ship. They managed to steal a [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] from the base and they returned to a small [[Lurmen/Legends|Lurmen]] village to warn them about the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Defoliator/Legends|weapon]]. Lok Durd attempted to destroy the [[Lurmen/Legends|Lurmen]] village with this weapon, but it was destroyed in the subsequent [[Defense of Maridun/Legends|battle]] by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. He was then arrested by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] along with [[Pune Zignat/Legends|his companion]].<ref name="Defenders" />

The mobile command center was also used as a basis for [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] [[TZ-33/Legends|TZ-33's]] [[Separatist outpost (Felucia)/Legends|outpost]] on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]].<ref name="Padawan Lost" />
